items.prompt: Complete B's reply with 話說回來.

sentence.traditional: 可是話說回來，有些人不敢嘗試。

sentence.pinyin: Kěshì huàshuō huílái, yǒuxiē rén bù gǎn chángshì.
sentence.english: But then again, some people do not dare to try.

repairs.note: 太危險 is a complaint about the activity; the reply needs a point about people, so use 有些人 and 不敢.

items.fallbackRepair: Start with 話說回來, then give your different view of the people.
